item.sandstorm.survival_datapad.desc: Handheld terminal with operational terraforming guidelines
gui.sandstorm.datapad.title: I.A.T.I. - Planetary Directives Terminal
gui.sandstorm.datapad.chapter.1: CHAPTER I: CRASH LANDING & INITIAL ADAPTATION
gui.sandstorm.datapad.chapter.2: CHAPTER II: UNDERGROUND AQUIFERS & SILICON METALLURGY
gui.sandstorm.datapad.chapter.4: CHAPTER IV: SEISMIC DEFENSE & HEAVY MECHANIZATION
quest.sandstorm.suit_diagnostics.title: Suit Systems Diagnostics
quest.sandstorm.suit_diagnostics.task: Check fused spacesuit status and conserve its solar energy reserve.
quest.sandstorm.suit_diagnostics.note: I.A.T.I.: The suit regulates temperature and oxygen. Ship cabin provides thermal shielding.
quest.sandstorm.compact_sandstone.title: Dune Engineering: Sandstone
quest.sandstorm.compact_sandstone.task: Collect sand blocks from the entry ramp and compact 4 sand into Sandstone.
quest.sandstorm.compact_sandstone.note: I.A.T.I.: Sandstone serves as primary structural material in the absence of wood.
quest.sandstorm.emergency_workbench.task: Access the cabin workbench or assemble a new one using 4 Sandstone blocks.
quest.sandstorm.emergency_workbench.note: I.A.T.I.: Enables crafting structural rods and advanced 3x3 machinery.
quest.sandstorm.sandstone_furnace.title: Sandstone Thermal Furnace
quest.sandstorm.sandstone_furnace.task: Construct a furnace using 8 Sandstone blocks at the workstation.
quest.sandstorm.sandstone_furnace.note: I.A.T.I.: Essential for glass melting, silicon processing, and fluid purification.
quest.sandstorm.glass_canister.title: Glass Canisters
quest.sandstorm.glass_canister.task: Smelt sand in the furnace to acquire glass and craft containment bottles.
quest.sandstorm.glass_canister.note: I.A.T.I.: Glass canisters withstand the mineral acidity of underground brine.
quest.sandstorm.brackish_brine.title: Brackish Water Extraction
quest.sandstorm.brackish_brine.task: Excavate below Y=60 to locate the aquifer and fill your glass bottles.
quest.sandstorm.brackish_brine.note: I.A.T.I.: Subsurface water contains toxic salt levels. Never drink without purifying.
quest.sandstorm.thermal_purification.tas: Boil the brackish water bottle in the furnace to yield potable water and salt.
quest.sandstorm.thermal_purification.not: I.A.T.I.: Potable water restores hydration levels and prevents biological collapse.
quest.sandstorm.silicon_smelting.title: Raw Silicon Smelting
quest.sandstorm.silicon_smelting.task: Subject sand to intense heat in the furnace to extract Raw Silicon.
quest.sandstorm.silicon_smelting.note: I.A.T.I.: Fundamental semiconductor for logic circuits and navigation sensors.
quest.sandstorm.silicon_wafer.title: Silicon Wafer Lamination
quest.sandstorm.silicon_wafer.task: Refine raw silicon in the furnace to laminate ultra-pure silicon wafers.
quest.sandstorm.silicon_wafer.note: I.A.T.I.: Wafers act as substrate for nano-conductors and integrated logic.
quest.sandstorm.circuit_manufacturing.ta: Combine silicon wafers, raw silicon, and copper to manufacture circuit boards.
quest.sandstorm.circuit_manufacturing.no: I.A.T.I.: Copper wire and components can be salvaged from Buried Tech Ruins.
quest.sandstorm.desalination_system.task: Build the Desalination Filter block for automated water purification.
quest.sandstorm.desalination_system.note: I.A.T.I.: Eliminates ongoing furnace fuel consumption for water production.
quest.sandstorm.additive_printer.title: Lithographic 3D Printer
quest.sandstorm.additive_printer.task: Assemble the 3D Printer for additive manufacturing of precision mechatronic parts.
quest.sandstorm.additive_printer.note: I.A.T.I.: Fabricates high-precision mechanisms impossible to forge manually.
quest.sandstorm.anomaly_sensor.title: Seismic Scanning Radar
quest.sandstorm.anomaly_sensor.task: Craft the Anomaly Radar to detect buried ruins and subterranean tremors.
quest.sandstorm.anomaly_sensor.note: I.A.T.I.: Alerts approaching sandworms and pinpoints salvage coordinates.
quest.sandstorm.seismic_thumper.title: Seismic Ground Thumper
quest.sandstorm.seismic_thumper.task: Build and deploy a Thumper on sandy ground to produce rhythmic pulses.
quest.sandstorm.seismic_thumper.note: I.A.T.I.: Rhythmic vibrations draw giant sandworms away from your base camp.
quest.sandstorm.sonic_defense.title: Sonic Dispersion Defense
quest.sandstorm.sonic_defense.task: Assemble the acoustic pulse Sonic Cannon for self-defense against predators.
quest.sandstorm.sonic_defense.note: I.A.T.I.: Emits shockwaves that repel and disorient hostile biological entities.
quest.sandstorm.nanite_assembler.title: Molecular Nanite Fabricator
quest.sandstorm.nanite_assembler.task: Construct the Nanite Fabricator to synthesize actuators and reconfigure matter.
quest.sandstorm.nanite_assembler.note: I.A.T.I.: Capable of synthesizing cutting-edge parts and rebuilding lost Datapads.
quest.sandstorm.mecha_assembly.title: Industrial Assembly Bay & Robotics
quest.sandstorm.mecha_assembly.task: Deploy the Assembly Bay and Drone Dock to construct heavy robotic equipment.
quest.sandstorm.mecha_assembly.note: I.A.T.I.: Heavy excavation vehicles break deep consolidated rock that manual tools cannot.
quest.sandstorm.atmospheric_probe.title: Atmospheric Biosphere Probe
quest.sandstorm.atmospheric_probe.task: Construct the Atmospheric Analyzer and survey planetary aridity indices.
quest.sandstorm.atmospheric_probe.note: I.A.T.I.: Computes aerosol dispersal rates required for stable terraforming.
quest.sandstorm.planet_terraformer.title: Planetary Atmospheric Terraformer
quest.sandstorm.planet_terraformer.task: Construct and power the Atmospheric Terraformer to establish the environmental dome.
quest.sandstorm.planet_terraformer.note: I.A.T.I.: Establishes an oasis microclimate shielded from heat and dust storms.
quest.sandstorm.planetary_genesis.title: New Genesis: Restored Biosphere
quest.sandstorm.planetary_genesis.task: Expand the terraforming field until barren sand converts to grass and lush flora.
quest.sandstorm.planetary_genesis.note: I.A.T.I.: Mission accomplished. The hostile desert blossoms as humanity new sanctuary.
